_comment: Plugins this workspace expects, but deliberately does NOT vendor.
Four of these are GPL-3.0 or AGPL-3.0. Committing their built main.js into a
public MIT-licensed template would redistribute copyleft binaries under an
incompatible license. They are two clicks each from Obsidian's own plugin
browser, so the cost of not vendoring them is small and the cost of vendoring
community-plugins.json still lists them, so the enable-list travels with the
clone. `./workspace obsidian-setup` reports which are missing.
